kjv: for thou (Yahweh) hast magnified thy word above all thy name
mine: for you (Yahweh) have exalted above all things your name and your word
note: MT higdalta 'al-kol-shimkha 'imratekha "you have made your word great above all your name" is awkward; I follow the common emendation 'al-kol shimkha we'imratekha "above everything, your name and your word"; the KJV keeps MT literally.
